title: MikroTik RouterOS: security flaw used in attacks
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 67 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.

category.label: Routers, cameras and devices
category.why: Routers, cameras and recorders are often forgotten and rarely updated.
category.doThis: Update it or replace it. Never leave its admin page open to the internet.

summary: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 28, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

kevDue.label: CISA deadline for US federal agencies
